question.text: Under Section 12 of The Weapons of Mass Destruction and Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005, which persons are prohibited from facilitating prohibited transactions?

answer.text: Any person who is a resident in India

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 12 of the WMD Act 2005 provides that no person resident in India shall knowingly facilitate, for consideration under an actual or implied contract, execution of any prohibited or regulated transaction under the Act. The covered category is any person resident in India, not a narrower professional or institutional group. The Trap: The prohibition is NOT limited to government employees, banks, or SEBI-registered entities. It also requires (i) residence in India, (ii) consideration under an actual or implied contract, and (iii) knowing facilitation — these qualifiers are part of the statutory test. Note: The covered-person category and the three statutory qualifiers above are grounded in the checked workbook page.
